newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen sees gaming stock upturn.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen sees gaming stock upturn.

text.p: Cowen & Co analyst Hal Vogel Friday said he sees gaming and lodging industry stocks, which have lagged the stock market's rally, on the upturn.
-- In written research, Vogel said "in spite of the recent capacity additions, we believe the gaming group has bottomed ut. The next six to 12 months, however, will likely be a period of 'catch-up'."
-- said better-than-expected casino revenues in Las Vegas and Atlantic City have triggered buying interest.
-- said short covering could provide added boost to stock.
-- has buy ratings on ITT Corp, Mirage Resorts Inc and Circus Circus Enterprise Inc.
